description.text: Choose a 2D point to track, leave the 'point ref time' to zero to leave the point 'C' out of the computation

description.plain_text: @b;PointsTo3D:@n When first called up you need to attach an image and its corresponding tracked camera.There are 3 points A,B&C. Each point has to correspond to the *same* 2d feature at different camera positions.So basically choose the point you want to resolve, place 'A' on that point at a particular frame and click the 'set frame' button for 'A'.Now, change the frame to a different camera angle and specify that same 2d feature with 'B' and hit 'set frame'and do the same thing for point 'C', again on a different frame. Hit 'calculate'and you now have the point in 3d space as well as that point converted back to screen space
